title: Elena Armijo on the Inc. 5000 talk — 'growth is not the risk. Drift is'
summary: An executive coach in the Inc. Leadership Forum distils the Dallas talk into the instruction she is taking home: name the one principle you would protect over money, and build the structure that protects it before the pressure arrives.
blockquote: 1. Name the one principle you’d protect over money. Eric Ries’s message was that growth is not the risk. Drift is. Build the structure now that protects what matters most, before the pressure arrives.
attribution_title: Executive Coach · Inc. Leadership Forum member
